notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 161-162) contains only the HVACR Fundamentals (AS) degree section, not the HVACR Fundamentals Certificate of Achievement section, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for the certificate.

The AS section lists core HVAC 101, 102, 103, 104 (3 units each) plus electives 'Select any combination totaling at least 6.00 units' from WEE 99I, Construction, Business and Entrepreneurship, and Computer emphasis courses; Total Hours/Units 18. All 18 closed-list courses appear there. The certificate likely mirrors this, but a reviewer should locate the certificate's own section (probably elsewhere in the catalog) to confirm.
The AS section prints four Program Student Learning Outcomes (the fourth continues on page 162); these were not copied because they are printed for the AS award.
